exposure: Manual chart review for surgical site infection surveillance
Algorithm-based identification for surgical site infection surveillance
cohort: The study participants were women who underwent cesarean section.
finding: A semi-automated algorithm achieved 97.5% sensitivity and 83.9% specificity for detecting surgical site infections after cesarean section, while also reducing the workload for infection control personnel.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for women undergoing cesarean section between January and June 2017.
